# Anjanna Margam Professional Portfolio

Official portfolio: https://anjannaportfolio.jaivibe.com/
Person entity: https://anjannaportfolio.jaivibe.com/#person
Profile page: https://anjannaportfolio.jaivibe.com/#profilepage

Anjanna Margam is a retail merchandise planning professional and founder of JaiVibe in India.

Documented professional background:
- Landmark Group / Max Fashion, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia, October 2004–May 2015: sales and buying budgets, OTB, forecasting, allocation, replenishment, retail stock and margin management, store expansion support and BOSS-to-Oracle Retail system transition.
- Beside Group, Dubai, June 2015–November 2020: international multi-brand merchandise planning across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar and Egypt.
- JaiVibe, since June 2020: websites, SEO, digital marketing, CRM workflows, lead generation and reporting.
- Sri Supraja Infracon, since January 2026: real estate and digital marketing strategy, online lead journeys, project positioning and sales-process support.

Reported Max Fashion planning scope: approximately SAR 600 million in sales and buying budgets, regional expansion from 5 to 22 stores, and support for 21 store launches. These figures refer to planning responsibility and contributions, not ownership of the stores or business revenue.
